description: Source code for HTTP header manipulation interfaces in the lighttpd server, including functions for parsing, setting, getting, and removing HTTP headers, as well as handling line folding and header offsets.

methods.name: http_header_hkey_get
methods.description: Get HTTP header enum value by case-insensitive header name.

methods.name: http_header_hkey_get_lc
methods.description: Get HTTP header enum value assuming lowercase header name.

methods.name: http_header_str_to_code
methods.description: Convert a 3-digit string to its integer code.

methods.name: http_header_str_contains_token
methods.description: Check if header string contains a specific token.

methods.name: http_header_remove_token
methods.description: Remove all instances of a token from a header buffer.

methods.name: http_header_response_get
methods.description: Retrieve a response header value.

methods.name: http_header_response_set_ptr
methods.description: Set response header to an empty buffer and return pointer.

methods.name: http_header_response_unset
methods.description: Remove a response header.

methods.name: http_header_response_set
methods.description: Set a response header to a specific value.

methods.name: http_header_response_append
methods.description: Append a value to a response header.

methods.name: http_header_request_get
methods.description: Retrieve a request header value.

methods.name: http_header_request_set_ptr
methods.description: Set request header to an empty buffer and return pointer.

methods.name: http_header_request_unset
methods.description: Remove a request header.

methods.name: http_header_request_set
methods.description: Set a request header to a specific value.

methods.name: http_header_request_append
methods.description: Append a value to a request header.

methods.name: http_header_env_get
methods.description: Retrieve an environment variable as a header.

methods.name: http_header_env_set_ptr
methods.description: Set environment variable header to empty buffer and return pointer.

methods.name: http_header_env_set
methods.description: Set environment variable header to a specific value.

methods.name: http_header_env_append
methods.description: Append a value to an environment variable header.

methods.name: http_header_parse_unfold_impl
methods.description: Unfold folded header lines.

methods.name: http_header_parse_hoff
methods.description: Parse header offsets and handle line folding.
